variables.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
variables.description: Username for the single administrator account used to log in to the admin portal.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for the administrator account. Choose a strong unique password before using the app.

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Long random secret used to sign the admin session cookie. Generate one with `receipt-upload generate-secret-key --raw`.

variables.name: UPLOAD_TOKEN
variables.description: Secret token used in the private cardholder upload URL at `/upload/{UPLOAD_TOKEN}`. Generate one with `receipt-upload generate-upload-token --raw`.

variables.name: APP_BASE_URL
variables.description: Public base URL for the app, used when showing the upload link in the admin portal.

variables.name: MAX_UPLOAD_MB
variables.description: Maximum total upload size in megabytes for one receipt submission.
